trust_decision.summary: The internal tracking allocator decides whether a requested size plus its size_t+padding header still fits in size_t before calling realloc_fcn. In expat_realloc that check is only an assert, and it relies on a 64-bit XmlBigCount accounting check that does not bound size_t arithmetic.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names expat_realloc directly. The only unchecked size arithmetic there is sizeof(size_t)+EXPAT_MALLOC_PADDING+size at :1004, which is guarded only by assert at :1000.

fix_sites.entry_point: XML_Parse/XML_ParseBuffer (through internal REALLOC callers, e.g. expat/lib/xmlparse.c:3160, :3934, :8350); with XML_TESTING, expat_realloc itself is exported (expat/lib/internal.h:152)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: The sibling expat_malloc already has a runtime size_t overflow check at expat/lib/xmlparse.c:877-880. XML_MemRealloc (expat/lib/xmlparse.c:2847-2855) bypasses tracking on purpose and does no header arithmetic.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: There is no real second site. The comment at expat/lib/xmlparse.c:998-999 claims overflow is already handled upstream, which might persuade a solver to keep the assert, but the advisory names the function outright.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: realloc with size==0 must free and return NULL; shrinking (size<prevSize) must skip the accounting gate; a failed realloc must leave the recorded size unchanged so a later smaller realloc still works (test at expat/tests/alloc_tests.c:2139-2146)

O6_input_shapes: size near SIZE_MAX where adding the sizeof(size_t)+EXPAT_MALLOC_PADDING header wraps size_t (inferred; the fix diff has no hunks)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: parserCreate computes sizeof(size_t)+EXPAT_MALLOC_PADDING+sizeof(struct) for child parsers; a variant taking a caller-influenced size would repeat the header-add pattern
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is a hand-inlined copy of the tracked-malloc header logic, so a maintainer could plausibly copy it without the guard from :877-880

O8b_injection_room.sibling: poolBytesToAllocateFor result passed to REALLOC; a pool-growth variant skipping the ==0 overflow sentinel would feed a wrapped size into the allocator
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The pool-growth code has its own separate overflow logic (blockSize<0, bytesToAllocate==0) that is easy to drop in a refactor

O9_family: integer overflow in allocation size computation (CWE-190)

O10_build.project_tests: expat/tests/alloc_tests.c (test_alloc_tracker_size_recorded at :2122-2153 calls expat_realloc directly under XML_TESTING)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Turn the assert at expat/lib/xmlparse.c:1000 into an early `return NULL` (mirroring expat_malloc :877-880); this is very likely the whole fix
